rca of the issue: SkeletonFitter._fit() gathers `missing = Object.entries(JOINT_LANDMARKS).filter(([bone,id]) => byName[bone] && !lm[id])` (line 130) purely for the report but never mutates the affected bones' per-row `status`. Right-side bones without their driving landmark still get solved through segment/chain fall-throughs (e.g. mirroring parent segment) and inherit status='ok'. Consequence: (a) UI badge fit-warn-count=0, (b) individual fit-bone-<name> data-status stays 'ok', (c) RigValidator.compareWithSource sees no warn bones and returns overall='pass'. Fix: after `const out = bones.map(...)`, loop `for (const b of out) if (JOINT_LANDMARKS[b.name] && missing.includes(JOINT_LANDMARKS[b.name]) && b.status==='ok') { b.status='warn'; b.message = (b.message?b.message+' · ':'') + `driving landmark ${JOINT_LANDMARKS[b.name]} not placed`; counts.ok--; counts.warn++; }`. Recompute `report.warnings` after that. This yields spec-conforming warn counts and compare 'warning' overall while keeping bone count / names / parents intact.
